items.title: United Airlines Pushes Back Airbus A321neo Coastliner Debut To “Early 2027”
items.summary: United Airlines' Airbus A321neo Coastliner is NOW set to enter regular scheduled service early next year. The airline had hoped to debut this new aircraft by the end of this year, but, after facing delivery delays from European aircraft manufacturer Airbus, the planes will not operate regular service operations until 2027.
